rendered:
The paper "Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials" reports a 1.4 Ah lithium-ion pouch cell that kept 65.7% of its initial capacity. 

This was after 1000 cycles, and at 1 C/2 C rates.

prompt.system: You answer questions using only the documents below: pages selected from them, with tables written row by row. Answer briefly. If you compute a number, show the calculation. If the question assumes something the documents contradict, say so. If the documents do not hold the answer, say so.

expect: cssc-2020 ('Sustainable Direct Recycling of Lithium-Ion Batteries via Solvent Recovery of Electrode Materials'): 1000 cycles at 1C/2C (p2.L99-101)
